review.notes: Triage review within a fixed time budget. All 52 pages passed an automated normalized 4-gram containment diff (PDF text layer vs OCR markdown) plus a full code-fence balance scan (12 markers, 6 balanced blocks, no swallowed structure). Line-level word-diff spot checks on the lowest-containment main-text pages 7, 9, 10, 12 and 25 found no droppage (residual gaps are benchmark column names inside the image-embedded Table 2 and figure-internal color words in appendix demo screenshots). Pages 41, 43, 47 and 48 were rendered at 110-200 dpi and visually verified for every patch. The appendix demo boxes (physical pages 40-52) are screenshot-style boxes whose labels and code the OCR partially transcribes as text/fences by the document's own mixed convention; low containment there is explained by embedded screenshots, and was machine-scanned only.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.41 prints "A.3 Video Understanding" as a bold section heading in the same style as the sibling headings A.1, A.2 and A.4. The OCR left it as a plain paragraph line, which the shared normalizer cannot repair because it only renumbers existing heading markers. The shared exporter normalizes '## A.3 ...' to the same depth as the sibling appendix headings.

Rendered physical p.47 shows the 'Function Calling - Code Interpreter' demo as a single black-framed box in which 'Function Input' is a white-on-black label strip above the code, identical to the 'Function Result' and 'Model Response' strips on physical p.48; it is a demo-box label, not a document heading. The OCR promoted it to a level-2 heading, which would surface it in the document outline next to real sections.

Rendered physical p.48 shows 'Model Response' as a white-on-black label strip inside the same demo box, not a document heading; rendered physical p.41 shows the same strip style in another demo. The OCR promoted it to a level-2 heading. Demoted to plain text, matching the doc's own treatment of such labels elsewhere (table cells in the Figure 24 demo, fence text in the Figure 19 demo).

Rendered physical p.43 (200 dpi crop, visually verified) prints the model response inside the Figure 24 demo as '<|object_ref_start|>the red car<|object_ref_end|><|box_start|>(701,531),(869,675)<|box_end|>'; the PDF text layer matches. The OCR cell garbled the special tokens, keeping only '(the red car(701,531),(869,675)<'. Angle brackets are restored as HTML entities, following the existing escaping convention inside that table.

unresolved.evidence: The Figure 24 demo table (physical p.43) and the Figure 30 UI-agent transcript table (physical p.51) reference nested images (images/8c3d3908..., images/e315a45b... and the Screenshot_N sequence) that are absent from the package; reader-content/index.json already records them under missing_nested_images. A cleanup patch cannot add image embeds.

The appendix demo boxes mix treatments: some are pure embedded screenshots, some transcribe labels/code into fences or tables, and banner strips such as 'Function Calling - Code Interpreter' are omitted from the transcription. Only the two label strips that OCR promoted to level-2 headings were repaired; a uniform re-transcription of the demo boxes is a larger editorial decision.
